name: Nath Bio-Genes (India) Ltd
title: Nath Bio-Genes (India) Ltd - 537291 - Announcement under Regulation 30 (LODR)-Earnings Call Transcript

read.thesis: Seed company with FY26 revenue INR 4,316m (+19%) and gross margin down to 56% from 63%; inventory build to INR 4,446m and FY27 guidance of 15-20% top-line growth, with no capacity expansion (capex mainly land and vehicles).

capex.quote: Nath has not been investing much in CapEx. If you go through my balance sheet, so you will find that we have only land bank as CapEx

triggers.label: Inventory up to INR 4,446m
triggers.quote: Inventory increased to INR 4,446 million, in line with our planned scaled up for the upcoming season

triggers.label: Gross margin 63% → 56%
triggers.quote: The year saw a major normalization of gross margin from the elevated 63% in FY25

triggers.label: FY27 top line growth 15-20%
triggers.quote: we expect the top line to be growing between 15 -20% around that time, and I'm again being conservative

triggers.label: Cotton stock build; production overshoot
triggers.quote: this year, when we gave a 100, we got almost 70-80

guidance.quote: we expect the top line to be growing between 15 -20% around that time
the EBITDA margin would be maintained with the slightly upward trend in EBITDA as well as in the net profit margin

red_flags.label: Operating cash flow negative; inventory building
red_flags.quote: as per the formula, it is definitely going negative by about INR 13 crores

red_flags.label: Inventory rising since FY24 despite revenue growth
red_flags.quote: Inventory is going up and up since March 2024?

red_flags.label: Finance costs up 39% on working capital
red_flags.quote: Finance costs increased to INR 133 million from INR 96 million in FY25

red_flags.label: Management admits production overshoot and carrying cost
red_flags.quote: I know carrying inventory is a little costly affair

evasions.topic: Uzbekistan revenue targets and market share
evasions.quote: we have not yet put in any targets financially
Now, that is very difficult to predict in the cotton market.
